title: Identity self symmetry of an even shifted etale line
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and Y a scheme. Let J be a sheaf of A-modules on the small etale site of Y, etale locally isomorphic to the unit A_Y, and let d be any integer. The canonical signed symmetry of the derived tensor on L tensor L, for L=J[2d], is the identity morphism. Use the unbounded derived category and shiftedLine and swap of [def-sfb-etale-coordinate-trace-data].

proof.text: Apply etaleLineFlatAndBraiding to obtain flatness and ordinary identity self braiding. Then specialize evenShiftCanonicalSelfSymmetry to the ordinary etale sheaf category. Unfold only the published swap, shiftedLine and tensor wrappers to identify the required canonical symmetry.

proof_origin.place: Second triangle, final even-shift paragraph. P3 writes the ordinary etale local-unit argument, the single-complex summand calculation, and canonical K-flat localization cancellation in Lean using existing source-library APIs, without the general ringed-site comparison packages.

lean.statement:
theorem evenLineSelfSymmetry {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (J : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hJ : Scheme.IsLisseRankOneSheaf J) (d : ℤ) :
    (swap A Y (shiftedLine A J d) (shiftedLine A J d)).hom = 𝟙 _
